title: confiture test-db drop --format json
description: The outcome of dropping one confiture-managed clone or template (its backends are terminated first). Assembled by the command. A database that is not confiture-managed is refused without --force, and the refusal writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

dropped.description: True when the database existed and was dropped; false when it did not exist (not an error: the command exits 0).

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
